how: No alpine terrain near Sydney; the nearest high mountains are the Snowy Mountains (Mount Kosciuszko, 2,228 m, a walk-up summit), roughly 5-6 hours by road to Jindabyne.
Needs reliable snow; Sydney has none, and the nearest snowfields are Perisher and the Kosciuszko National Park around Jindabyne, roughly 5-6 hours away by road and winter only.
No flooded natural cave systems exist around Sydney's sandstone basin; the nearest recognised water-filled caves and sinkholes are at Mount Gambier, South Australia, over 1,000 km away.
No suitable flying hills inside the metro area; the nearest and best-known hang gliding and paragliding site is Stanwell Park (Bald Hill), about 59 km south of Sydney, roughly an hour's drive.
